description: This file defines the AssetService class for managing assets via HTTP requests in an Angular application, including methods for CRUD operations, querying, and bulk import.

classes.name: AssetService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to interact with asset-related API endpoints, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and bulk operations.

methods.name: getTenantAssetInfos
methods.description: Fetches paginated asset info for a tenant, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getTenantAssetInfosByAssetProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves tenant asset info filtered by asset profile ID.

methods.name: getCustomerAssetInfos
methods.description: Fetches customer-specific asset info with pagination and optional type filter.

methods.name: getCustomerAssetInfosByAssetProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves customer asset info filtered by asset profile ID.

methods.name: getAsset
methods.description: Retrieves a specific asset by its ID.

methods.name: getAssets
methods.description: Retrieves multiple assets by their IDs.

methods.name: getAssetInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a specific asset.

methods.name: saveAsset
methods.description: Creates or updates an asset, with optional save parameters.

methods.name: makeAssetPublic
methods.description: Publishes an asset making it publicly accessible.

methods.name: assignAssetToCustomer
methods.description: Associates an asset with a customer.

methods.name: unassignAssetFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes asset association from a customer.

methods.name: findByQuery
methods.description: Searches for assets matching a query.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds an asset by its name.

methods.name: assignAssetToEdge
methods.description: Associates an asset with an edge device.

methods.name: unassignAssetFromEdge
methods.description: Removes asset association from an edge device.

methods.name: getEdgeAssets
methods.description: Retrieves assets associated with a specific edge device.
